rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow the printed option order). Item 1 date takes three combs (MM, DD, YYYY) in order. Part III rows 27-30 print with those numbers while the layout keys are numbered 33-36; the keys are matched to the printed rows in order (Cash/Bank Debit Memo, Check, Tax Debit Memo, Others) by their Drawee Bank/Number/Amount captions. Part III amounts pair a peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). Part III dates are three combs per row and stay blank. The product rows and Schedule 1 rows on page 2 have no column captions in the text layer and stay blank. Layout keys for the Part II region/province codes, the Part III tax computations 16-24 (except Item 18, the page 2 grand total), and the page 2 TIN have no fillable cells.
